_comment: FAQPage schema — add to every blog post for FAQ rich result eligibility.

mainEntity.name: What is the best cap table management tool for startups?

acceptedAnswer.text: Carta is the most widely used cap table platform, managing equity for over 40,000 companies. However, Pulley and AngelList offer more affordable alternatives for early-stage startups.

mainEntity.name: How much does cap table software cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pricing ranges from free (Pulley's starter tier) to $1,000+/month (Carta's enterprise plans). Most Series A startups pay $200-400/month.

notes: Use real questions from GSC query data, not made-up FAQs
